evant data to be maintained over power down cycles.
⌋
7.4.3 Daemon crash
In case the DM daemon crashes for some reason, it will as most as possible be
restarted "silently", so that the adaptive applications can still run without a restart.
In chapter " 7.3.1.3" the caching for DEM related features is described to be able to
re-sync after a daemon restart.
